searchText: Can you run `fill` in parallel? Yes, just use `fill -n auto` 70s, still slow 🙂 Yes I think one of the bottlenecks is having to spawn a process for each call to t8n, eels team has a prototype which makes t8n a server, and it’s even faster than geth for filling
